vault.title: Keydka Shakhsi
vault.subtitle: Goobo shakhsi ah oo kaliya lagu furo browser-ka loona akhriyi karo server-ka sidii qoraal furan.
vault.setup_description: Furaha keydka waxaa laga sameeyaa browser-ka. Server-ka wuxuu kaydiyaa oo kaliya furaha la duubay iyo rikoodhada la siray.
vault.setup_warning: Haddii aad lumiso erayga sirta ah ee qufulka iyo furaha soo kabashada labadaba, xogta lama soo celin karo.
vault.passphrase_placeholder: Xulo eray sir ah oo xooggan ugu yaraan 12 xaraf
vault.passphrase_confirm_placeholder: Gali erayga sirta ah mar kale
vault.protection_item_1: Magaca shayga, sharraxaadda, barcode-ka, qiimaha, taariikhda, iyo garantiigu waxay ku jiraan sirta browser-ka.
vault.protection_item_2: Server-ku waxa uu arkaa oo kaliya boorsada sirta ah, tirada shayga, iyo waqtiga la diiwaangeliyey.
vault.protection_item_3: Sii deynta ugu horreysa waxay si ula kac ah u tahay mid gaar ah oo diiradda saaraysa qoraalka; wadaagista iyo warbaahintu waxay u baahan tahay hab kala duwan oo ammaan ah.
vault.unlock_description: Waad furi kartaa boorsada adigoo adeegsanaya ereygaaga sirta ah ama furaha soo kabashada ee hore u keydisay.
vault.unlock_passphrase_placeholder: Geli ereygaaga sirta ah ee boorsada
vault.security_note_1: Furaha sanduuqa wuxuu ku jiraa kaliya xusuusta daalacashada. Waxaa la nadiifiyaa markaad ka baxdo bogga ama sanduuqa xirto.
vault.security_note_2: Haddii aad iloowdo erayga sirta ah, waxaad isticmaali kartaa furaha soo kabashada. Haddii labada la lumiyaan, waxyaabaha ku jira si joogto ah looma heli karo.
vault.recovery_ready_title: Furaha Soo Kabashada Wuu Diyaarsan yahay
vault.recovery_ready_description: Waxaan tusnaa furahan hal mar oo keliya. Ku keydi meel ammaan ah.
vault.recovery_visible_once: Furahan dib mar dambe lama soo bandhigi doono.
vault.record_form_subtitle: Tani waxay raacdaa habka caadiga ah ee walxaha si dhow, laakiin qoraalka cad weli ma baxayo biraawsarka.
vault.barcode_privacy_hint: Koodhadhka qafiska lama baaro adeegyada dibadda si toos ah; qoraalka koodhka waxaa lagu kaydiyaa si sir ah.
vault.empty_description: Ku bilow adigoo ku daraya rikoodhkaaga shakhsiga ah ee ugu horeeya
vault.empty_filter_title: Ma jiraan rikoodhyo la jaan qaadaya shaandhada hadda
vault.empty_filter_description: Isku day raadinta kale ama hagaaji shaandhada
vault.delete_confirm: Ma hubtaa inaad rabto inaad tirtirto rikoodhka this vault?

preview.title: Habka hordhaca
preview.body: Qaybta dambe ee boggan laguma gaari karo tijaabada maxalliga ah hadda. Weli waad dib u eegi kartaa qaabka iyo socodka marka hore; waxaan dhaqaajin doonaa dhinaca server-ka ka dib markaad ogolaato.

legal.privacy_policy_content: Asturnaantaadu waa muhiim noo ah. Codsigan wuxuu si ammaan ah u kaydiyaa xogta aad soo geliso iyadoo la adeegsanayo sirta heer-beereed. Ma iibino mana la wadaagno xogtaada shaqsiyeed dhinacyada saddexaad. Adigoo adeegsanaya adeegga, waxaad ogolaatay uruurinta xogta lagama maarmaanka ah ee maamulka akoonka iyo shaqeynta codsiga.
legal.terms_of_service_content: Adigoo adeegsanaya {{brandName}}, waxaad ku heshiinaysaa shuruudahan. Adeegga waxaa la bixiyaa 'sida uu yahay' iyada oo aan dammaanad lahayn. Waxaad masuul ka tahay xogta aad soo geliso iyo hubinta inaad leedahay xuquuqda ku saabsan. Waxaan xaq u leenahay inaan joojino akoontooyinka ku xadgudba siyaasadaha ama ku xadgudba nidaamka.
legal.register_consent: Waxaan akhriyay, fahmay, waxaanan ku heshiinayaa <1>Shuruudaha Adeegga</1> iyo <2>Siyaasadda Khaaska ah</2>.
legal.consent_subtitle: Fadlan xaqiiji shuruudaha hadda ka hor inta aadan sii wadin.
legal.consent_notice: Waxaan u baahan nahay aqoonsi la duubay oo ku saabsan Shuruudaha Adeegga iyo Ogeysiiska Asturnaanta hadda ka hor inta aadan sii wadin isticmaalka codsiga.
legal.consent_checkbox: Waxaan aqbalayaa Shuruudaha Adeegga waxaana xaqiijinayaa inaan akhriyay Ogeysiiska Asturnaanta.
legal.consent_required: Waxaad u baahan tahay inaad xaqiijiso Shuruudaha Adeegga iyo Ogeysiiska Asturnaanta ka hor intaadan sii wadin.

cookies.banner_text: Waxaan isticmaalnaa kukiyada muhiimka ah si aan kuu hayo saxiixan oo aan u xafidno kalfadhigaaga. Adigoo sii wadaya isticmaalka goobtan, waxaad ku heshiinaysaa siyaasadayada.
